channel.title: News Bot — TechCrunch AI (Tech & AI)
channel.description: RSS-Feed für die Quelle 'TechCrunch AI' (Kategorie: Tech & AI).

item.title: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
item.description: At 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.

item.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
item.description: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.

item.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
item.description: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.

item.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
item.description: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
item.description: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

item.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
item.description: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

item.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
item.description: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

item.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
item.description: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
item.description: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
item.description: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
item.description: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

item.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
item.description: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.
